title: pm-dispatch(review): the seat requests the approvers in the same round as its ACCEPT, large-diff PRs included, and never reports "awaiting approval" before the request is sent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB1HYv38UREmspmKSByfEg1B)_

No card: maintainer-directed in the project thread (「修改 pm-dispatch/os-dev 技能」, after 「为什么等我批的现在没有推送給 os-zhuang，是技能的问题吗」).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`SKILL.md`〈路径分叉〉三行就地改写(行数不变):③ 请审在席位 ACCEPT + 现 head PASS 落案的**同一轮**发出;>3000 行 PR 明写也走 ③ 请审;④ 轮报现读请审人,**没请审就不许在聊天里说「等你批」**。
- 为什么改:规则(10-29 的 #27385)本来就要求席位交棒时请审 os-zhuang/hotlong,但席位没执行:#30028 已有 ACCEPT + 同 head PASS 却无人被请;#29993、#29998 这类 >3000 行拆分 PR 被「Tier S 不交人」误读成不请;聊天里却报了「等你批」。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本 3 行,不动脚本、门禁、workflow;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L187、L197、L201。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint && pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`,三条皆绿(行数 319/319,每行 ≤120 字节)。
- 需要你做的:审阅并批准本 PR(`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,但这是 PM 自身规则 PR,按〈路径分叉〉末行留给维护者)。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, three lines rewritten in place (319 lines before and after, each ≤120 bytes):

- **L197, step ③:** the approver request (`pr_request_reviewers`) goes out in the **same round** that the seat's ACCEPT and a same-head contract PASS are both on record, not "after" at some later point.
- **L187, the >3000-line rule:** it already swaps ACCEPT for the four end-of-review steps with no Tier S exception; it now names step ③ explicitly, so L198's "Tier S hands off to nobody" no longer reads as covering a large diff on ungoverned paths (the split PRs).
- **L201, step ④:** the round report reads the requested reviewers live, and a seat never reports a PR to the maintainer in chat as awaiting approval before the request is on the PR; it sends the request first.

`os-dev.md` is unchanged: a dev's `pr_create` still carries no assignees and requests nobody. That is the rule the maintainer asked for on 2026-10-29 (「这个是技能的bug，应该是开发完了你审核通过才会推送给我审核」, 「审核人是 os-zhuang 和 hotlong」), landed in #27385, and this PR keeps it. Only the seat-side hand-off is tightened.

## Why

Measured on 2026-11-04 ~10:10Z, the six PRs reported in chat as waiting for the maintainer:

| PR | Seat ACCEPT on current head | PASS on current head | Requested reviewers before | os-zhuang review |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #29968 | yes | yes | none | APPROVED |
| #30004 | yes | yes | none | APPROVED |
| #30028 | yes (09:11Z) | yes | **none** | none |
| #29993 (35,227 lines) | no | no (PASS names an older head) | **none** | none |
| #29998 (24,422 lines) | no | no | **none** | none |
| #30030 | no | yes | **none** | none |

#30028 was a due hand-off with no request. The two splits are over 3000 lines and owe the same end-of-review steps, but L198's "Tier S hands off to nobody" plus a patrol (H43) that reads only register paths left them with no request and no warning. As a one-off, `os-zhuang` was requested on #30028, #29993, #29998 and #30030 from the project thread; #29968 and #30004 already carry an `os-zhuang` approval, so they wait on the seat's landing, not on a review.

Out of scope, follow-up if wanted: H43 in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` reads governed-register PRs only, so it cannot flag a >3000-line PR whose request is missing.

## Verification

The 20 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff, run on head `262327bc`, all exit 0 (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`). Key lines:

- `check-skill-line-ratchet`: green, SKILL.md at its 319 ceiling.
- `check-skill-id-lint`: 110 files clean.
- `check-skill-frame-sync` and `check-governed-prose`: green.
